title: Cornerman drop-worker task packet (schema v2)
description: Task packet contract for the Cornerman headless drop worker. Models the full lifecycle (idea -> brief -> agent -> proof -> review -> commit/PR) even though the Slice 1 worker only validates and reports. Slice 1 never performs model calls, scheduler installs, patch creation, commits, pushes, PRs, or proof. Authoritative design: lifepunch/docs/handoff/CORNERMAN_HEADLESS_DROP_WORKER_OPUS_V2_PLAN_2026-07-06.md (Part B).

schemaVersion.description: Packet schema version. Slice 1 worker accepts version 2 only.

id.description: Unique packet id: task-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-<slug>. Must match the inbox filename (<id>.json).

type.description: Task kind. dxrp-official packets are limited to review/audit kinds by allowedOutputTypes.

owner.description: Optional accountable owner for the task (default: Bloodwave).

repoProfile.description: Repo/lane profile. Resolved against the profile registry (repo-profiles.json) on the worker node. The worker never infers a profile.

repoPath.description: Authoring-node repo path (informational). The worker resolves the actual clone from the profile registry and verifies remotes; it does not trust this path.

baseRemote.description: Base remote. lifepunch-private: origin. dxrp-official: upstream (law).

baseBranch.description: Base branch. lifepunch-private: main default, develop only when explicitly targeted. dxrp-official: develop (read as upstream/develop).

reviewBranch.description: Optional. Required when reviewing an existing PR branch (dxrp-official). Read-only; never checked out.

routeTag.description: Model routing tag (warm target on Green). Slice 1 records it; no model is called.

focus.description: Lane focus. Must agree with repoProfile (LifePunch <-> lifepunch-private, DXRP <-> dxrp-official). Never both.

model.description: Reserved for Slice 2+. Local model endpoint config. Slice 1 validates shape only and never calls it.

inputs.description: Grounding inputs. All paths are repo-relative to the resolved profile clone; absolute paths and '..' traversal are rejected.

maxBytes.description: Hard cap on total input bytes.

requiredDocs.description: Optional canon docs the task depends on (repo-relative).

contextNotes.description: Optional free-text context from the authoring node.

instruction.description: What the task asks for. Distill/audit instruction, not an implementation order.

allowedOutputTypes.description: Explicit allow-list. The worker refuses to emit any artifact type not listed here.

forbiddenScope.description: Explicit deny-list, e.g. ['portal', 'permissions-backend', 'lifepunch-ip']. The worker rejects work touching these.

requiresMaintainerApproval.description: Default true for any implementation-adjacent dxrp-official task. When true, implementation-adjacent output is blocked without a maintainer-approval GO flag.

mode.description: report = distill/audit output only (Slice 1). candidate-patch = future GO-gated mode (Slice 5); ALWAYS rejected by the Slice 1 worker.

slice.description: Optional workstream slice id (e.g. H10, T3) for traceability.

phase.description: Optional lifecycle phase label (idea | brief | agent | proof | review | commit-pr).

doNotTouch.description: Optional explicit path/topic deny-list layered on top of forbiddenScope.

deliverable.description: Output contract for the outbox artifact.

outboxName.description: Base name for outbox artifacts (no path separators or extensions).

expectedSections.description: Optional required sections in the report.

proof.description: Reserved: proof/verification EXPECTATIONS for downstream Red work. Cornerman never claims runtime proof; these fields only drive checklist generation.

evidenceExpected.description: Evidence items Red must produce (screenshots, clips, status output).

review.description: Reserved: review gates for the downstream lifecycle. Slice 1 records them into the report checklist only.

commit.description: Reserved: commit AUTHORITY hints for Red. The worker never commits or pushes; when commit.allowed is false the report must state 'commit forbidden' and carry no commit instructions.

pr.description: Reserved: PR authority hints for Red. The worker never opens PRs; pr-body drafting additionally requires 'pr-body' in allowedOutputTypes.

constraints.description: Safety policy. Defaults are enforced by the worker regardless of what the packet says; the packet may only restate or tighten, never loosen.
